title: Drum size, tuning the snare and bass drum
summary: Hall and Allen talk about his drums, shell depth and tuning the bass drum to a pitch.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: See. How thick a shell do you use? A five or six inch or how big is it? Do you know? Is it a fairly deep one or is it shallow?
I don't remember. The drum that I have now? Yeah. Oh no, it's about a... Here's a picture. Yeah, that's one of the drums I have. No. Is that the tom-tom? No, that's a drum.
Looks like about a six and a half or something like that.

Yeah, I used to use a big one. But that went out of the same time. I used to use them that big. Big as the tom-tom. Oh yeah, like on parades. Yeah. That's right. But no, it's a way of tuning a drum. Now I've had guys use my bass drum. You see, I tune my bass drum up.
Well, Baby Dodds told me he always does tune my bass drum up. Oh yeah, right these fellas like them soft down, you know.
I don't know. I tune, I've even tuned them out up to 10. A certain key on the key on the key. Yeah, that's a big one.
I think you said he was. Sure. Yeah, tune them up. One of them to B and one to A or one to E or something. A certain pitch.

Like I said about the studio drummer, I told him what to do and he came back the next week and said, it's fine now. Yeah. He loved the way I told him. I said old man Contra, taught me how to, he said all the way to let your drum down unless the weather gets too tight. But he said when you're tight, keep it up all the time. Don't let it down, because no matter what you do you can get it back in the same place again. So that's why my drums sound so good. And so far everybody that came out of the club, I would play it on my drums, said, how do you keep your drums this way? I said I don't like them. I had one boy play one night, and he turned mine down. He wanted that blabber sound like, I call it battle sound. No, no I don't tune, I keep mine up. It has nice sharp sound.
